name: DeepInfer
note: DeepSeek's open-source engine for V4.1 Flash
summary: DeepInfer is the inference framework DeepSeek uses to serve DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in production, released as open source in October 2026. It builds on DeepSeek's kernel libraries (FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP) and adds attention data parallelism, MoE expert parallelism, speculative decoding, batch-invariant inference and structured outputs. The public release covers offline inference only; the KV cache system, prefill/decode disaggregation and load balancing are not included.
facts: NVIDIA SM100 GPUs, Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs
Offline inference; no KV cache system, P/D disaggregation or replica load balancing
Originally built on vLLM; ideas from SGLang and TensorRT-LLM
goodFor: Self-hosting DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with DeepSeek's own optimizations
Large deployments on NVIDIA SM100 or Huawei Ascend 950
Studying a production MoE serving design
watchOut: Runs one model on two accelerator families for now
Offline only; you supply KV cache, P/D disaggregation and load balancing
Efficient deployments start at about 64 prefill plus 64 decode GPUs
